card.name: Punctuation after fetal ultrasound warning text
card.fires_on: Commas and periods ending a clause, mostly in the ACE-inhibitor pregnancy warning about ultrasound and oligohydramnios. It also fires on a few sentence-ending marks elsewhere.

modes.label: Oligohydramnios warning
modes.description: Comma or period right after 'intra-amniotic environment' or 'oligohydramnios is observed' in the pregnancy warning.
modes.example: If oligohydramnios is observed<<,>> discontinue quinapril and hydro

modes.label: Other sentence ends
modes.description: Periods or commas ending a clause in scientific or infection text.
modes.example: Treatment with antibacterial agents alters the normal flora of the colon leading to overgrowth of C. difficile<< .>> C. difficile produces toxins A and B

card.plain: It marks the punctuation point in a stock fetal-monitoring warning, where a new instruction or sentence follows.
